title: Snapped Labels
intro: The snapped meshes, their records and the CT they sit on read straight from these URLs, logged out. Every segment is a tifxyz folder, so VC3D, villa and anything that reads tifxyz opens it as it is.

sources.title: Snapped labels: every segment, with index.json and checksums
sources.license: CC BY-NC 4.0 (derived from Vesuvius Challenge open data)
sources.note: One folder per segment, SCROLL/SEGMENT/: snapped.tifxyz, abstain.tif, confidence.tif, reason.tif, source.tif (finesnap), release_mask.tif and release.json (source URLs, sha256 of every file, summary). index.json lists every segment; viewer/ holds the page's cross sections.

sources.note: Same grid and voxel frame as the published mesh it came from (release.json names it), so the two line up vertex for vertex; -1 where there is no vertex or it was held back.
